messages.content: tell me about BHIM and BBPS

BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money) and BBPS (Bharat Bill Payment System) are two different but related initiatives by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).

BHIM is a Unified Payments Interface (UPI) based digital payment system that enables users to send and receive money using a virtual payment address linked to their bank account. BHIM was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December 30, 2016.

BBPS, on the other hand, is a bill payment system that allows customers to pay their bills (such as electricity, water, gas, telephone, mobile, DTH, insurance premiums, mutual fund transactions, school/college fees, tax payments, etc.) through multiple modes and channels such as cash, cheque, demand draft, net banking, mobile banking, USSD, Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), Quick Response (QR) code based payment, etc. BBPS was launched on January 16, 2017.
